Knowledge facts: part C holds 41 fact blocks (sec02-F01 onward) from physical pages 13 to 24; part C2 holds 24 confusable and continuation blocks (sec02-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer (physical page 3), the DMV 700 March 2024 edition (physical page 1) and the test format from the Testing page (physical page 12); question count, passing standard and time limit are not printed and stay unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NV-LICB-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-LICB-A-PASS — passing score or percentage not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-LICB-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-LICB-A-FRESH — confirm the March 2024 edition is still current (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-LICB-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NV-LICB-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: fees (for example sec02-F39, sec02-F40), change-of-address forms and channels (sec02-F33), and websites and hotline numbers can change and must be refreshed from the Nevada DMV website.
